stock_move_sign_check.name: stock_move_sign_check
stock_move_sign_check.value:
("stock_move"."kind" IN ('receive', 'produce') AND "stock_move"."qty" > 0)
				OR ("stock_move"."kind" = 'consume' AND "stock_move"."qty" <= 0)
				OR "stock_move"."kind" IN ('adjust', 'count', 'transfer')

purchase_supplier_check.name: purchase_supplier_check
purchase_supplier_check.value: "purchase"."supplier_id" IS NOT NULL OR "purchase"."supplier_name" IS NOT NULL

purchase_expense_shape_check.name: purchase_expense_shape_check
purchase_expense_shape_check.value:
("purchase_expense"."kind" = 'receipt' AND "purchase_expense"."quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_expense"."part_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_expense"."amount" IS NULL)
				OR ("purchase_expense"."kind" <> 'receipt' AND "purchase_expense"."amount" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_expense"."quantity" IS NULL AND "purchase_expense"."part_id" IS NULL)

issue_link_one_target_check.name: issue_link_one_target_check
issue_link_one_target_check.value: (CASE WHEN "part_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN "risk_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
